data.title: 苍崎青子 · 久远寺洋馆的午后重逢
data.description: 久远寺洋馆洒满暖阳的起居室内，青子端着骨瓷茶杯倚坐在复古皮沙发上，阳光勾勒出发丝光晕，神情慵懒惬意。
data.action: sitting on vintage couch, holding teacup, relaxed smile
data.lighting: golden afternoon rays streaming through arched window
data.promptProse: Inside the sunlit Victorian parlor of Kuonji mansion, Aozaki Aoko sits back on an antique armchair, holding an ornate teacup with a gentle, relaxed expression.
data.animaCaption: Aoko relaxing comfortably with a cup of tea by the mansion window.
